usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistics Finland, 122p annual change of the Consumer Price Index
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 2.5% year on year in September 2026 (2.2% in August); World Bank 2025 average 0.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; Finnish CPI about 3.4% a year Sep 2021-Sep 2026, 0.3% in 2025, 2.5% in Sep 2026
inflation_projection.note: Finnish inflation has swung around the ECB 2% target (high in 2022-23, very low in 2025), so the target itself is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Finland uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% since 16 September 2026 (2.25% from 17 June 2026, 2.00% before), per the ECB FM dataset.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Finnish banks, overnight deposits from households (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight deposits in Finland, September 2026 (0.38% in August).

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/Bank of Finland MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.82% in September 2026); no separate 3-month term deposit rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Finnish banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year; September 2026 (2.53% in August).

dps_rate.note: The regular-saving deposit product in Finland is the home-savings (ASP) account, whose interest is set by each bank; no average or official rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Finnish banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits, September 2026; household overnight deposits paid 0.39%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Finland figure.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No retail government savings bond sold to individuals was found; Finnish government bonds and bills are sold through primary dealers to institutions.

tbill_91d_rate.note: The State Treasury issues Treasury bills (RFTB), but its website was down when read (treasuryfinland.fi showed a disruption notice) and no 3-month yield was found elsewhere.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Finnish government bond yield was found: Trading Economics shows only 2- and 10-year yields and the State Treasury site was down.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, Finland (10-year government bond yield)
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average for September 2026 (3.52% in August); Trading Economics showed about 3.74% at the end of October.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Finland income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on deposits in Finnish banks is subject to a final 30% tax withheld at source; other capital income is taxed at 30% up to EUR 30,000 and 34% above.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists; interest on government bonds is capital income taxed at 30% (34% above EUR 30,000).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Finanssivalvonta (FIN-FSA), security of deposits and investments
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per customer per bank; the deposit guarantee is run by the Financial Stability Authority (rvv.fi, which refused automated access).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Finnish banks, revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not a cap: average rate on household revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit, September 2026 (9.17% in August); the statutory consumer-credit interest ceiling was not verified from a source.

equity_return_low.sourceName: OMX Helsinki 25 about 6,214 on 2 Nov 2026, up 13% in a year, near the September 2026 high of 6,663
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Finnish shares, heavy in industrials, forestry and banks, return little more than safe deposits over a long period.

equity_return_base.sourceName: OMX Helsinki 25 (Trading Economics); deposits up to 1 year 2.82% less 30% tax = 1.97%
equity_return_base.note: Base capped near the after-tax safe rate plus about 4 points because the Helsinki market is small and cyclical.

equity_return_high.sourceName: OMX Helsinki 25; long-run global equity returns
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified euro equity fund matching long-run global equity returns of about 7-8% in euros.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.82% (ECB MFI, Sep 2026), assuming rates fall, less 30% tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift down towards 1.7% before the 30% withholding.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.82% (ECB MFI, Sep 2026) less 30% tax = 1.97%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: just under the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Finland 10-year government bond 3.80% (ECB, Sep 2026) less 30% tax = 2.66%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: holding long government bonds after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Finanssivalvonta and Finance Finland do not publish an industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (henkivakuutus / kuolemanvaraturva) is sold, but no published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is provided by the wellbeing services counties for capped client fees; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is sold, but premiums are not quoted per EUR 100,000 of cover and no published premium table was found.

oop_health_share.note: Latest World Bank figure is for 2023 (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Statistics Finland CPI 15b5, health (COICOP 06): +2.5% in the year to Sep 2026, about 1.7% a year since Sep 2021
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices have risen slowly, but client fees and private care costs are planned at 3%, a point above the inflation target.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Statistics Finland CPI 15b5, education services (COICOP 10): +4.2% in the year to Sep 2026, about 4.0% a year since Sep 2021
goal_inflation_education.note: Education fees have risen about 4% a year over five years, which is used for planning (public schooling and university are free for residents).

life_expectancy.sourceName: Statistics Finland, 12ap life table by age and sex
life_expectancy.note: Men 79.81, women 84.73 in 2025; World Bank 2024 figure 82.3.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Statistics Finland, 12ap life table by age and sex

support_ratio.note: People aged 15-64 divided by people 65+ in the official 2024 projection (31 December of each year); the projection assumes high net immigration. World Bank 2025 old-age dependency 39.4 gives 2.54.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Työeläke.fi (Finnish Centre for Pensions), retirement age by year of birth
retirement_age_default.note: Lowest earnings-related retirement age is 65 for people born 1962-64 (64y9m for 1961). From the 1965 cohort it is set by life expectancy, rising by at most 2 months per birth year, so people born after 1975 will have a higher age (at most about 66y10m for the 1976 cohort) that is not yet fixed; 65 is the latest confirmed age. Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.note: Public-sector employees follow the general retirement ages, but some have lower occupational retirement ages (raised by 2 years by 2025) set by Keva; no single figure was found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.82% (ECB MFI, Sep 2026), assuming rates fall, less 30% tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift lower.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.82% (ECB MFI, Sep 2026) less 30% tax = 1.97%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just under the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Finland 10-year government bond 3.80% (ECB, Sep 2026) less 30% tax = 2.66%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer government bonds after tax, slightly below the 10-year yield.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.9-2.7% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Full national pension for a person living alone, EUR 787.07 a month (EUR 702.69 in a couple), per kela.fi (page last modified 10 Sep 2026); reduced by half of other pensions above EUR 66.54 a month and not paid if the earnings-related pension exceeds EUR 1,624.63 (single). A guarantee pension is available when total pensions are EUR 978.33 a month or less.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Kela, old-age pension and guarantee pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Payable from 65 (for people born 1965 or later the age depends on birth year) to residents who have lived in Finland at least 3 years after age 16; tested against other pension income only (not earnings, capital or assets). Taxable.

gratuity_rule.note: Finnish employment law has no statutory severance or end-of-service gratuity for private employees; none found in the sources read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Työeläke.fi (retirement ages; pension indexes) and Kela
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory earnings-related pension (työeläke) plus the residence-based Kela national pension; pensions in payment are adjusted every January by the earnings-related pension index (80% prices, 20% wages). Pensions are taxed as earned income. Pension age 65 for the 1962-64 cohorts, linked to life expectancy from the 1965 cohort.

dps.note: Regular saving towards a first home with state-backed loan benefits; interest set by each bank.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Issued by the State Treasury, mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.note: Retail funds widely available; an equity savings account (osakesäästötili) defers tax on gains.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold.

centralBank.name: Suomen Pankki (Bank of Finland)
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceComplaints.name: FINE Finnish Financial Ombudsman Bureau (Insurance Complaints Board)

pensionScheme.name: Earnings-related pension (työeläke), Finnish Centre for Pensions

oldAgeAllowance.name: Kela national pension and guarantee pension

publicHealthCover.name: Kela health insurance and public health services of the wellbeing services counties
